summary.sign_convention_note: RVR frame: +pitch aligns with +arctan(grad_along); +roll aligns with -arctan(grad_cross) (starboard down)
summary.scientific_interpretation: Orbital DEM (20 m/pixel) smooths sub-pixel rocks, ripples, and wheel-scale (~3 m) terrain undulations captured by Perseverance IMU pitch/roll telemetry. Additionally, Perseverance actively steers around local hazards, keeping 99%+ of its actual traverse below 16 deg.
